body:
REMAINING 8 FAIL-OPEN SITES, PARTITION ONLY. window.scala:122 is closed at 3468dce. I did not reserve paths and I did not fix anything.

CRITERION remains m1's: `x <= 0.0` / `== 0.0` fails open; `x > 0.0` fails closed.

| site | polarity | reachability | consequence (read, not run unless noted) |
|---|---|---|---|
| population.scala:178 `m <= 0.0` | fail-open | CONDITIONAL. `m` is column mass from `AlignmentRow` sums. Public `AlignmentRow.of` rejects NaN. `private[align] apply` can mint it. Same chain as MassRatio — second link behind a well-formed row. |
| population.scala:267 `totalFlow <= 0.0` | fail-open | CONDITIONAL. Same: `totalFlow` is a sum of those masses. If NaN arrives, ELSE publishes `Estimate.observed(bw/totalFlow)` = Observed(NaN). |
| matrix.scala:175 `sourceMass <= 0.0` | fail-open | CONDITIONAL. `sourceMass` is a sum on the row. Public door well-formed ⇒ finite. In-module apply can poison it; localizability then computes on NaN. |
| matrix.scala:217 `z <= 0.0` | fail-open | CONDITIONAL. `normalized` then divides by NaN and calls `private[align] apply`. |
| density.scala:154 `z <= 0.0` | fail-open | PUBLIC INPUT. `discourse(..., bandwidth: Double = 0.03)` is public. `bw = math.max(bandwidth, 1e-6)`: Java `Math.max(NaN, 1e-6)` is NaN, so the floor does not save it. Then cdf terms are NaN, `z` is NaN, ELSE divides by NaN. `Density.toTrack` then `Estimate.observed(values(k))` — not `score`. I did NOT execute this; polarity + public signature + IEEE max. |
| hsmm.scala:810 `z <= 0.0` | fail-open | CONDITIONAL. `z = sourceMass * sourceMass` on existing rows. Diagnostic only, not `reweight`. If NaN, `Some(NaN)`. |
| Smatch.scala:28 `p + r == 0.0` | fail-open IF NaN | NOT REACHABLE. `p`/`r` are `Int` ratios (`matched.toDouble / totalLeft`). Structurally immune. |
| assess.scala:112 `total <= 0.0` | fail-open IF reached | NOT REACHABLE. Line 108 already refuses `isNaN` / infinite / negative. NaN never arrives at :112. |

TALLY of m1's 11 fail-open sites:
  settled earlier: sinkhorn (reachable, degenerate plan), MassRatio (conditional), window:122 (closed 3468dce)
  this instalment: 2 immune (Smatch, Distribution.of), 5 conditional behind AlignmentRow.of (population x2, matrix x2, hsmm diagnostic), 1 public-input candidate (density bandwidth NaN)

I have not run the density bandwidth case. That is the next measurement if anyone wants a live/not-live answer rather than a permits answer. No bead for a fix until that run.
